positions.invalidation: Close the pay if March 2027 SOFR trades at or below 4.40, which would unwind the inflation impulse. Do not add a euro short or a yen short to soften it.
positions.thesis: October CPI at 0.4 percent and Brent at 95.82 leave cash SOFR at 3.89 low versus a path that is only 4.615 by March 2027. The two-year at 4.86 and the ten-year at 5.1 show the impulse is already in the cash curve, which is a reason to size the pay so a squeeze does not threaten the book, not a reason to receive in front of oil and the CPI print. Canada and Australia are different paths. Dollar-yen at 159.70 is the wrong dollar expression. The concentrated book is one outright March SOFR pay…

pms.thesis: The March 2027 SOFR short stays the hike-path pay. Implied yield near 4.60 is still well above the 3.90 fixing, and the two-year at 4.88 is higher than that future. WTI at 88.56 and Brent at 95.84 are softer than the old triple-digit case, but equities are firm and the VIX is 18.7, so the mix still supports the pay. Risk capital on this short is already at the 10 million limit, so the book holds and does not add.

positions.thesis: That is the first 2027 three-month contract that prices a Canadian hiking cycle (+84bp vs CORRA cash 2.29) after 1m CORRA still only reaches 2.58 by Dec-2026 and Dec-26 3m CRAZ26 is 2.775. August labor (-42k, wages +2.0%) and CPI-trim/median 1.9/2.0 do not support delivering that 2027 path. Side long is duration-long in implied-rate space (profits if the 3.13 implied falls toward the still-alive near-term path).

pms.thesis: Hold the 150 million March 2027 Canada receive. The contract near 3.03 still prices a large hike premium over cash near 2.30, and that is the size that would be initiated if the book were flat. Canada inflation sits after this cutoff, so there is no new print to resize against. The US SOFR pay and the dollar legs leave a Canada-only backup intact.

pms.label: Grinder
pms.mandate: Preservation and consistency first. Smaller sizes, high hurdles, quick de-risking. No-trade is valid.
pms.thesis: Stay flat. Official SOFR at 3.90 percent is the zero-alpha place for an empty book. March 2027 SOFR already prices about 4.60 and December about 4.31, so paying a hike the futures already contain does not clear a high hurdle. Euro-dollar at 1.1052 is an extended trend, not a fresh edge over funding. The Canada bill premium is real, and Canada inflation is after this cutoff, so it is not a reason to deploy today.
